title: A 40 mph Wind Twisted a Steel Bridge Until It Fell

scenes.text: A steel bridge twisted like a ribbon, then fell.
In 1940, a brand new bridge in Washington State met a forty mile an hour wind.
The deck started rolling in waves, about twelve times a minute.
After more than an hour, the 2,800-foot main span tore apart and dropped into the water.
The only death was a dog named Tubby. Watch it again.

description:
A steel bridge twisted like a ribbon, then fell.
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge collapsed on November 7, 1940, in a wind of about 40 mph. Did you know wind could do that?
thumbnail_text: WIND TORE DOWN A STEEL BRIDGE
